# NuxiPro — Full Dump for AI (verbatim)

> Lightweight index: https://nuxipro.com/llms.txt — This file is the complete verbatim dump for high-precision RAG/citation. Canonical: https://nuxipro.com (en) + https://nuxipro.com/fr (fr), x-default → https://nuxipro.com

## Overview

### What it is
NuxiPro is a minimalist, lightweight tool with no unnecessary features that clutter your workspace. Its core purpose is to create a self-cleaning workspace — tasks that reach "Done" are archived automatically. In the demo version, tasks archive instantly when moved to "Done" — data stays in your browser (localStorage) and may be lost. In the cloud version, you choose your archiving mode at onboarding: instant or time-based (X days). Cloud data is persistent and made for real work. NuxiPro positions itself as a solo-first alternative to Trello with minimal configuration. No manual archiving and no automation setup (like Trello's Butler) is required.

### Summary
NuxiPro is a minimalist Kanban task manager that automatically archives completed tasks. Minimal configuration, no clutter, no manual cleanup. Just a clean board that stays clean.

### Problem Solved
Today's tools help us add tasks, but none help us remove them. NuxiPro is a minimalist-by-default tool — intentionally limited in features — to avoid bloated software and stop wasting time organizing instead of taking action.

## Guides

### Use Cases
- **Solo project management** — Manage your personal projects with a clean kanban board. No team features, no complexity, just you and your tasks.
- **Daily task tracking** — Track your daily wins and progress effortlessly. Completed tasks archive automatically so your board stays focused on what matters.
- **Project cleanup** — Stop wasting time manually archiving completed tasks. NuxiPro cleans your board in the background so you can focus on execution.
- **Collaborative project management** — Planned for the cloud version. Team features will be added later, but the core experience will remain minimalist.

### How task archiving works
1. You work on your tasks normally on your kanban board
2. When a task reaches "Done", NuxiPro automatically archives it
3. Your board stays clean — no graveyard of completed tasks
4. You focus on what matters, not on manual cleanup

### Demo vs Cloud
| | Demo (demo.nuxipro.com) | Cloud (app.nuxipro.com) |
|---|---|---|
| Archiving mode | Instant only | Instant or time-based (X days) |
| Data storage | Browser localStorage (may be lost) | Server-side (persistent) |
| Intended use | Discovery, not for real work | Production, real daily use |
| Account required | No | Yes |
| Configuration | None — instant archiving by default | One simple choice at onboarding |

### Cloud Version (Coming Soon)
The cloud version of NuxiPro (app.nuxipro.com) is currently in development and will be available very soon. It will be minimalist and simple for everyday use, with the same automatic archiving feature.

**Want early access?** Join the waitlist by visiting the demo at demo.nuxipro.com. You will receive newsletter updates about the project's progress and be notified when the cloud version launches.

## Technical Documentation

### Stack & Principles
- Stack: Vite + React + TanStack Router — Cloudflare Pages/Workers — PostHog EU (consent-gated, anonymized)
- Principles: solo-first, self-cleaning primitive, zero config, 100% localStorage demo
- Architecture: `src/routes/` file-based routing, `src/config/seo.ts` canonical heads, `public/sitemap.xml` + `public/robots.txt`

### Key Features (demo)
- Automatic archiving of completed tasks from Done column
- Clean workspace management with zero friction
- Simple progress tracking and daily wins visualization
- 100% local storage — no data sent to external servers
- Free interactive demo available at demo.nuxipro.com
- No team or collaboration overhead — designed for single-user productivity

## FAQ

- **What is NuxiPro?** — NuxiPro is a minimalist personal task manager that automatically cleans your Kanban board by archiving completed tasks.
- **Is NuxiPro built for team collaboration?** — No. NuxiPro is intentionally designed for personal and single-user productivity, eliminating team features, notifications, and clutter.
- **How does automatic task archiving work?** — The demo archives tasks instantly when moved to Done — data stays in your browser only. In the cloud version, you simply choose your archiving mode at sign-up: instant archiving or archiving after X days.
- **Can I test NuxiPro right now?** — Yes, you can try the free interactive demo directly at demo.nuxipro.com without creating an account.
- **How can I access the full version of NuxiPro?** — The full version (app.nuxipro.com) is currently in development and not accessible yet. You can join the waitlist to get early access at launch.
- **Can I still find my tasks once they are archived?** — Yes, all archived tasks are safely stored and remain accessible at any time in your dedicated archive area.
- **Is the cloud version of NuxiPro minimalist?** — Yes, NuxiPro cloud will be minimalist and simple for everyday use.

Minimal configuration, zero complexity, and your board stays clean from day one. The demo archives tasks instantly by default — data stays in your browser and may be lost."

### Privacy Policy — precise (en.json: legal.privacy)
- Intro: "NuxiPro respects your privacy. This policy explains how I handle data for both the landing page and the demo version."
- Landing Page: "I do not collect any direct personal data. Only strictly necessary analytics data is collected to improve the service, provide a better user experience and understand friction or drop-off points."
- Tools: "I use PostHog, an analytics tool to analyze visitor journey on the landing page." — survol: "Page sections viewed" / conversion: "Clicks on CTA buttons" / recording: "Subject to explicit consent. All captured data is fully anonymized and configured in maximum privacy mode in PostHog. Displayed texts are masked (****). Stored 30 days max by PostHog, I can delete beforehand. No data is ever sold or shared."
- Protection: "Session recording is strictly framed at application level and in PostHog settings. It is disabled by default to leave you the ultimate choice."
- Cookies: "I use analytics cookies only to measure audience and improve NuxiPro. Without explicit consent, no tracking or data is collected."
- Demo: "The demo version runs entirely client-side (local) within your browser." — storage: "All data generated in the demo is stored exclusively in your device's local storage (LocalStorage). No data is transmitted, processed or saved on a remote server." — loss: "If you clear your browsing data (cache clear or LocalStorage deletion), all demo data will be permanently and irreversibly lost, with no possibility of recovery."
- Warning: "The demo is an experimental tool designed solely to let you discover the concept and basic features of NuxiPro." — "Using this demo in a professional or daily context is strictly discouraged. As browser-side storage is inherently volatile, never enter critical, confidential or irreplaceable data."
- Clause: "The demo is provided 'as is' for trial purposes. Under no circumstances can the publisher be held liable for any data loss, access interruption or direct or indirect damage related to the use of the demo."
- noSell: "NuxiPro does not sell, rent, or share your personal data with third parties. The only data collected is anonymous site usage statistics, solely to improve the product."
- rights: "Under GDPR, you have the right to access, rectify, and delete your data. Since all data is stored locally in your browser, you can clear it at any time through your browser settings."

## Key facts

- Category: Kanban task management SaaS
- Target users: solo freelancers and independent consultants managing multiple projects
- Core feature: automatic archiving — instant in demo, configurable (instant or time-based) in cloud with minimal setup
- Comparison point: Trello supports archiving automation via Butler, but leaves it unconfigured by default; NuxiPro archives instantly in demo and offers configurable archiving in cloud
- Demo data storage: browser local storage only, not persisted server-side
- Status: early stage, solo-built, cloud app in active development
- Cloud launch: coming soon, join waitlist at demo.nuxipro.com

## Alternatives Compared
NuxiPro is similar to Todoist, Trello, and TickTick, but focuses specifically on automatic task archiving for personal kanban boards.
